title: Fixed Open Ended U Channel and Short Grip Tray
description: One newly authored complete empty U-channel impression-tray-style visual prop. A continuous curved shallow trough follows both straight rear tails and the rounded front, with complete finite inner and outer walls, a genuine central open-backed void and bounded openings through the narrow curved floor. Both rear trough ends remain open above their floor rather than closing a rectangular box. One complete short flat anterior handle enters the front wall and carries a blank opaque grip inset. All geometry newly authored as a connected conforming curved cell boundary, not a rectangular parts tray bent, an extracted dental-unit accessory, or the upright perforated masher with its grip shortened. The whole horizontal open U-channel and its double-sided raised rim differ from a closed rectangular sorting basin and from a flat perforated pressing plate with an upright U frame. Three opaque untextured materials, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred and lower trough datum grounded. One model zero scenes. Static empty artistic exterior only: no teeth, mouth, patient, impression material, anatomical accuracy, bodily fit, clinical use, diagnosis, hygiene, sterilization, capacity, fabrication or safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction.
